professions.name: Runic Blacksmithing
professions.description: Shape highland bog iron, dwarven silver, and meteoric star-iron into armaments, wards, and runic tools.

professions.name: Furrier & Leatherwork
professions.description: Cure northern hides, wolf pelts, and mountain timber into weather-proof mantles, scout bows, and hardy field gear.

professions.name: Northern Alchemy
professions.description: Distill glacier lichen, hearthstone amber, and draconic reagents into restorative draughts and enchanted vials.
